softwareMove.title: Software Move
softwareMove.desc: Move software user data (chat history, caches, etc.) from C: to another drive to free up system disk space.
softwareMove.empty: No known software data directories found.
softwareMove.confirmContent:
Move {{name}} ({{size}}) data from C: to {{target}}.

Make sure the application is fully closed before moving.
softwareMove.riskWarning: ⚠ Warning: Close the target application before moving. Running software may lock files and cause the move to fail. Power loss or forced shutdown during the move may cause data corruption. Back up important data first.
softwareMove.processesRunningContent: The following processes of {{name}} are currently running. They must be closed before moving.
softwareMove.forceCloseWarning: Force closing will immediately terminate the application. Unsaved data may be lost. Files that remain locked during copy will be skipped.
softwareMove.moveSuccessWithSkipped: {{name}} moved, but {{count}} files were locked and skipped

defender.title: Windows Defender
defender.desc: Disable Windows Defender real-time protection and anti-spyware.
defender.risk: ⚠ Warning: Disabling Windows Defender exposes your system to viruses and malware. Ensure you have another reliable antivirus installed.

update.title: Windows Update
update.desc: Stop and disable the Windows Update service.
update.risk: ⚠ Warning: Disabling Windows Update prevents security patches and feature updates. Your system may be vulnerable to known exploits. Check for updates manually on a regular basis.

folders.title: User Folders
folders.desc: Move user folders (Documents, Pictures, Downloads, etc.) from C: to another drive to free up system disk space. Changes take effect immediately.
folders.risk: ⚠ Note: A logout or Explorer restart may be needed for the change to fully apply. Close any applications using these folders first.
folders.noneOnC: All user folders are already on other drives.

virtualMemory.title: Virtual Memory (Page File)
virtualMemory.desc: Adjust the page file size on drive C. The page file extends available memory when physical RAM is full.
virtualMemory.restartHint: ⚠ Note: A system restart is required for virtual memory changes to take effect.
